verdict.rationale: Poke's docs show it taking on delegated tasks. It brings in real people for reservations, calls and orders, builds and deploys websites, and performs actions across connected apps through conversation, all inside an asynchronous messaging assistant. Nothing documents an explicit autonomous background-run mode or a review step before results are finalized. missing for 10: documented autonomous background execution of multi-step tasks, progress/status tracking, an explicit hand-back-for-review workflow, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can delegate a multi-step task that the assistant works on autonomously in the background and returns for my review

citations.quote: Poke can now bring in real people to take on tasks with a human touch - restaurant reservations, phone calls, placing orders, booking rides, and more.
Poke can also create and deploy websites for you at yourname.poke.com.
Once connected, Poke can access information and perform actions across apps and services through natural conversation.
